annotations.title: How to set up Candor UI

description: How to install Candor UI in a React or Next.js app, render a chat, connect an agent SDK, add licensed items and keep them updated. With `prompt: true`, only "Give this to your agent": one block of text for adopting Candor into an app that already exists (it asks about the stack and the agent's API first, installs with the CLI, leaves the licence key to the person and names the providers to wrap the app in).

prompt.description: true: only the adoption prompt, to hand to a coding agent.

version.description: A release, e.g. "2.6.2": the page as that release published it, for a project that has that version installed. Default: the version the server's URL passes (`?kit=`, which `npx candor-ui mcp` writes from candor-lock.json), else the current docs. When that release's docs weren't kept, or the page isn't in them, the answer is the current page with a note saying so.
